integrity: The complete adjacency list and synchronous update are specified. Two distinct complete-state classification algorithms, direct successor-support enumeration, and exhaustive graph-automorphism backtracking are included with exact outputs. No external independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Computer-assisted exhaustive theorem for one labelled 12-vertex graph; no universal four-regular graph or monotonicity theorem is claimed. Historically unindexed equivalent computations cannot be excluded.
title: Four-state Chvátal excitation: period collapse and six extremal symmetry classes
